findings.title: Remove forbidden host literal from comment
findings.text:
The new test in `tests/release_workflow.rs` asserts that the release workflow text does not contain
`<private-host>`, but this added comment embeds that literal host name, so the `forbid` check will fail.
Reword the comment so it explains the same fact without spelling out the public host.
findings.existing_code:
# The URL THIS RUNNER reaches Forgejo at (its own server URL: the one checkout uses), not the
# public tailnet name: the runner is a LAN container with no tailnet DNS, so
# https://<private-host> does not resolve there (first dispatch: "Could not resolve host").

findings.title: Preserve TLS 1.2 minimum floor
findings.text:
Replacing the hard-coded `--proto '=https' --tlsv1.2` with a scheme-derived `--proto "$proto"` also drops the
`--tlsv1.2` minimum, so an https server may be negotiated down to an older TLS version on token-bearing
requests. Keep `--tlsv1.2` (it is ignored for plain-http transfers) so the TLS floor is preserved when https is used.
